metadata.description: Small, focused utilities for coding agents. Each util is an independently installable plugin.

plugins.name: time-awareness
plugins.description: Keeps your agent aware of the current date & time on every turn — no more 'good night!' at 10am in long sessions.

plugins.name: html-deliverable
plugins.description: Turns 'make me an HTML page' into a polished single-file local page — invariant structure, four themes, evidence-first content.

plugins.name: live-qa
plugins.description: Drive a deployed environment in a real logged-in browser session and adjudicate each QA case from what actually renders — screenshot as evidence, or 'NO USER TO TEST WITH' and stop.

plugins.name: evidence-first
plugins.description: Blocks the agent from recommending technical work until it has produced a receipt — identifier, link, verbatim quote, causal tie — or reports NO EVIDENCE and stops.
